description: This file defines a React component for the public landing page of a silent auction platform. It provides UI for creating and joining events, with form validation, state management, navigation, and interaction with a backend database (via Supabase). It includes input fields, buttons, and user feedback mechanisms like toasts.

methods.name: onCreateInput
methods.description: Handles user input change for create event form, updating state and clearing errors.

methods.name: onJoinInput
methods.description: Handles user input change for join event form, updating state and clearing errors.

methods.name: focusFirstCreateError
methods.description: Focuses the first input field with a validation error in the create event form.

methods.name: focusFirstJoinError
methods.description: Focuses the first input field with a validation error in the join event form.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Simulates creating an event: generates a host link, attempts to insert into database, shows toast notification.

methods.name: onSubmitCreate
methods.description: Handles submission of the create event form: validates inputs, calls createEvent, manages loading state.

methods.name: onSubmitJoin
methods.description: Handles submission of the join event form: validates inputs, navigates to event page, shows toast.
